(1st award) | previous = [[2024 Ballon d'Or|2024]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2026 Ballon d'Or|2026]] }} The '''2025 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2025 Golden Ball'''}}) was the 69th annual ceremony of the [[Ballon d'Or]], presented by ''[[France Football]]'', recognising the best footballers in the world in the 2024–25 season. For the fourth time in the history of the award, it was awarded based on the results of the season instead of the calendar year. This was the period from 1 August 2024 to 13 July 2025 ([[2025 FIFA Club World Cup final|final]] of the [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]]) for the men's award, and to 2 August 2025 ([[2025 Copa América Femenina final|final]] of the [[2025 Copa América Femenina]]) for the women's award.
